derivation: middle voice from G5259 (ὑπό) and G2919 (κρίνω);
def: to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend)

occurrences.text: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
